createDialog.title: Add grading scale
createDialog.description: Give it a name and choose where it applies. You add the grades on the next page.
createDialog.classHelp: If a class has its own scale, that one is used for the class.

detail.copy: Copy to another class or year
detail.problemsHeading: This scale can't be saved yet:

detail.emptyText: Start from the national curriculum (NCTB) grades and change what you need, or add rows yourself.

problems.out_of_range: Row {{row}}: the range must be between 0 and 100.
problems.missing_zero: The lowest row must start at 0.
problems.missing_hundred: The highest row must end at 100.
problems.gap: Some marks have no grade — see the red part of the bar.
problems.overlap: Some marks have two grades — see the striped part of the bar.
problems.unknown: Something in the rows is not right. Check them and try again.

detail.leaveText: Your grade changes are not saved yet and will be lost.

bandEditor.title: Grade rows
bandEditor.help: Each row is a range of marks and its grade. A fail grade has no GPA.
bandEditor.enterHint: Press <k>Enter</k> in the last row's grade to add a row.

coverageBar.label: Grade ranges from 0 to 100 percent
coverageBar.hasGaps: Marks in red have no grade.
coverageBar.complete: Every mark from 0 to 100 has exactly one grade.
coverageBar.title: 0 to 100% — which marks get which grade

copyDialog.title: Copy grading scale
copyDialog.description: Copy the grades of "{{name}}" to another class or academic year.
copyDialog.occupiedError: That class already has grades for this year. Open it to change them.

recomputePreview.title: Confirm this change?

recomputePreview.errorMessage: Couldn't save the grade change. Please try again.
recomputePreview.approvalHint: You may be asked for extra approval before saving.

marksEntry.noExamsText: Marks can be entered once an exam is created.

marksSheet.submittedAt: Submitted on {{time}}. Only an admin can reopen it.
